ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, with $BC=4$, D and E are respectively the midpoints of $AB$ and $AC$, G and H are respectively the midpoints of $AD$ and $AE$, then what is the length of $GH$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of $AB$ and $AC$ respectively,\\
hence $DE$ is the median of $\triangle ABC$,\\
thus $DE=\frac{1}{2}BC=\frac{1}{2}\times 4=2$,\\
since $G$ and $H$ are the midpoints of $AD$ and $AE$ respectively,\\
hence $GH$ is the median of $\triangle ADE$,\\
thus $GH=\frac{1}{2}DE=\frac{1}{2}\times 2=\boxed{1}$.
